Comedian and jiu-jitsu coach Eddie Bravo shares his take on the new UFO whistleblower in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience. Bravo, Rogan's longtime friend, is famous on the show for embracing the wildest reading of any story. Rogan lets him build the case his way.

Bravo walks through what the whistleblower claimed and why he finds it convincing. Rogan plays the mildly saner friend, asking where the proof sits. The segment is less a briefing than a show of the pair's dynamic: one man chasing the fringe at full speed, the other half a step behind, laughing and listening.

Scholar Alan Levinovitz joins the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 1504 to talk about food myths. Levinovitz studies how health fads dress themselves in the language of religion and purity. His book on the subject treats gluten panic as a case study in modern belief.

He and Rogan pick apart the rules people swear by, from clean eating to miracle diets, and ask what proof sits under each one. Rogan brings the gym world's habits into the dock as well. The episode is a calm debunking session that still respects why food rules feel so powerful to the people who live by them.
